title: Geometric stalks commute with tensor products and scalar extension on the etale site
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with a geometric point $\bar y$, stalks at $\bar y$ being those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and let $Y_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For a ring $R$, a sheaf of left $R$-modules on $Y_{\Et}$ is a sheaf of abelian groups with a left $R$-module structure on every group of sections for which all restriction maps are $R$-linear; sheafification of presheaves of $R$-modules is that of [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

1. *(Tensor products.)* Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{\Et}$. Let $\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G$ be the sheafification of the presheaf $U\mapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G(U)$, and for $s\in\mathcal F(U)$, $t\in\mathcal G(U)$ write $s\otimes t$ for the image of $s\otimes t$ in $(\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G)(U)$. Then there is a unique $\Lambda$-linear map $\mathcal F_{\bar y}\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G_{\bar y}\to(\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G)_{\bar y}$ with $s_{\bar y}\otimes t_{\bar y}\mapsto(s\otimes t)_{\bar y}$, and it is an isomorphism, natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$ and compatible with the associativity, commutativity and unit ($\underline\Lambda\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F\cong\mathcal F$, with $\underline\Lambda$ the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]) isomorphisms on both sides.
2. *(Scalar extension.)* Let $\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a homomorphism of rings, not necessarily commutative, so that $\Lambda'$ is a $(\Lambda',\Lambda)$-bimodule, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of left $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{\Et}$. Let $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F$ be the sheafification of the presheaf of left $\Lambda'$-modules $U\mapsto\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F(U)$, and write $\lambda'\otimes s$ for the image of $\lambda'\otimes s$ in $(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F)(U)$. Then there is a unique $\Lambda'$-linear map $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F_{\bar y}\to(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F)_{\bar y}$ with $\lambda'\otimes s_{\bar y}\mapsto(\lambda'\otimes s)_{\bar y}$, and it is an isomorphism of left $\Lambda'$-modules, natural in $\mathcal F$; for homomorphisms $\Lambda\to\Lambda'\to\Lambda''$ it is compatible with the identifications $\Lambda''\otimes_{\Lambda'}(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda-)\cong\Lambda''\otimes_\Lambda-$ on stalks and on sheaves.
